subject: TracePlus LlamaIndex runtime adapter — integration & pilot proposal
messages:
From: Alex Liu <alex@traceplus.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@openprompt.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + LlamaIndex runtime tracing adapter idea

Connor — great to meet at the ecosystem summit last week. TracePlus is an APM-style tracing product for LLM runtimes; several ISVs have asked us for a lightweight adapter that hooks at the LlamaIndex/LLama-client layer to capture prompt spans, tool calls, and cache hits without instrumenting model servers.

We think a Redwood-specific integration (LlamaIndex -> TracePlus) could: 
- give customers request/span-level traces for prompt origin, retrieval calls, and downstream tool execution
- surface token-level latency hot spots across your Dedicated/Private runtime variants
- be low-overhead via sampling + async batching

Attached is a short architecture sketch and a rough SOW idea. Curious if youd be open to a pilot with one of your Dedicated customers (we can target a non-prod bucket first).

Thanks — Alex
TracePlus, Partnerships

Attachments: traceplus-llamaindex-arch-sketch.pdf (6 pages), traceplus-sow-draft.docx (stub)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Liu <alex@traceplus.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + LlamaIndex runtime tracing adapter idea

Alex — thanks, this looks promising. Quick notes from skimming the sketch: 
- Wed want the adapter to respect customer routing policies — no data plane changes; traces should be emitted from the SDK side (LlamaIndex client) so we avoid touching the serving runtime unless a customer opts in.
- Sampling + PII redaction are must-haves for enterprise customers; include a configurable redact list and token-level sampling controls in the SOW.
- Performance target: <2% p99 tail increase for standard request shapes. Can you add perf numbers for your async batching plan?

Next steps: 
1) Can you and Priya propose a two-week pilot scope we could run with a staging cluster?
2) Marissa, Karthik: can you review the SOW roughness once Alex shares samples?

Id also like to loop in Tessa for commercial fit if we move from pilot -> paid integration.

—Connor
Staff Product Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Liu <alex@traceplus.io>

Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@openprompt.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + LlamaIndex runtime tracing adapter idea — pilot SOW draft

Connor/Marissa — attaching a slightly expanded SOW and a short perf note from our SDK team. Highlights: 
- SDK-side adapter hooks into LlamaIndex's response pipeline (post-retrieval, pre-model-call, post-model-call)
- Default sampling 1% token-level, adjustable to 10% for pilot
- Async gRPC/HTTP export with buffer flush at 200ms or 2k events
- PII redaction: configurable regex + hash-only option
- Pilot goals: validate zero-code install for LlamaIndex users, observe latency overhead across host types (n1-standard, p4d-like)

Perf notes (brief): our microbench shows a 0.8% median token latency increase at 1% sampling, worst-case 1.9% p99 when batching disabled. Wed love Redwooddd run a controlled test.

Attachments: traceplus-sow-draft.docx, traceplus-llamaindex-arch-sketch.pdf

Alex
TracePlus

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TracePlus LlamaIndex runtime adapter — integration & pilot proposal

Connor — thanks for the ping and Alex for the SOW. My read: good fit for our Observability add-on; couple of internal concerns to resolve before committing to a pilot: 
- Security: where do traces land? We need explicit options for customer-controlled endpoints (no SaaS ingestion by default) and KMS/HSM support for any persisted artifacts.
- Compliance: sampling controls + redaction must be demonstrably effective; ask TracePlus for a simple test vector we can run against our QA data set.
- Engineering ownership: this is a client-side package we can host in our SDK repo (python/ts). Karthik — would you estimate a small effort to add a Redwood shim that flips on/off across deployment modes?

Karthik: thoughts on perf target and whether we can enforce default sampling at the SDK level? If we can guarantee default 1% sampling unless customer opts in, that addresses several risk items.

—Marissa
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TracePlus LlamaIndex runtime adapter — integration & pilot proposal

Quick feasibility notes from infra: 
- We can implement an adapter shim in our SDKs (py/ts) that wraps LlamaIndex calls and emits trace payloads asynchronously. Effort: ~3 dev-weeks across both SDKs to produce a production-ready package + tests.
- Sampling enforcement: SDK can enforce default 1% sampling via config and opt-in flags; server-side routing policies won't be impacted.
- For Dedicated/Private customers who block external egress, we can support an export-to-local-forwarder mode (push to an on-prem TracePlus collector or to a customer-managed endpoint).

Risks: need to validate memory pressure from buffering in long-running processes; will add backpressure controls to the SOW. Also want to validate that TracePlusd export protocol supports TLS mutual auth for our enterprise hops.

If Alex can sign off on mutual-auth for collectors and provide perf snapshots at 10% sampling, we can commit to pilot dates.

—Karthik
Principal Engineer, Runtime Integrations

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Liu <alex@traceplus.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TracePlus LlamaIndex runtime adapter — integration & pilot proposal

Alex — thanks for the rapid follow-ups and the SOW + perf note. Agreed on next steps below: 
- TracePlus: please confirm youd support TLS mutual-auth for collector endpoints and send a 10% sampling perf snapshot (p50/p95/p99) by EOD Mon (2027-03-29).
- TracePlus + OpenPrompt: provide a small test vector (PII-safe) we can run against our QA harness — Priya, appreciate your help here.
- Redwood: wed scope SDK shim work ~3 dev-weeks (Karthik) and will provide a stubbed install path for Dedicated customers (local-forwarder). Marissa: Id like commercial terms draft (pilot pricing, logo use) once pilot scope firmed.
- Tentative pilot window: 2027-04-11 -> 2027-04-25 (2 weeks).

If wed all confirm, Id like TracePlus to go ahead and issue the SOW revision with PII redaction, sampling defaults, and the mutual-auth collector option. We can start the legal review in parallel (NDA + pilot addendum).

Ack replies welcome — Id like to close scope this week.

Best,
Connor
Staff Product Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference
